data.one_liner: Full screen overlay menu for Flutter apps with customized items and gradients.
data.what_it_does: Provides a full-screen overlay menu that displays custom items and pre-styled circular gradient menu options. It handles backdrop dimming, safe area boundaries, and back button behaviors to close the menu cleanly.
use_when: You need a full-screen modal action menu or options picker.
You want custom round gradient buttons with labels as menu elements.
avoid_when: You need a standard drop-down menu or context menu attached to a specific anchor widget.
You are on a Flutter version older than 3.47.0 without using version 2.0.1.
strengths: Easy to invoke via static methods like FullScreenMenu.show().
Built-in support for system back gestures and buttons.
Predefined gradients and customizable menu items.
weaknesses: Requires Flutter 3.47+ for the latest version.
Limited to full screen overlays rather than anchored dropdowns.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
